request.question: In "apple-fy24.pdf", are the 2024 total net sales figures 94,930 and 391,035 contradictory? Explain their respective reporting periods.

answer.answer:
1. The total net sales figure of $94,930 (in millions) in "apple-fy24.pdf" represents Apple's net sales for the "Three Months Ended September 28, 2024," i.e., the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2024 [1].

2. The total net sales figure of $391,035 (in millions) in "apple-fy24.pdf" represents Apple's net sales for the "Twelve Months Ended September 28, 2024," i.e., the entire fiscal year 2024 [1].

3. These figures are not contradictory because they refer to different reporting periods: $94,930 is for the most recent quarter, while $391,035 is for the entire fiscal year [1].

2. The total net sales figure of $391,035 (in millions) in "apple-fy24.pdf" represents Apple's net sales for the "Twelve Months Ended September 28, 2024," i.e., the entire fiscal year 2024 [1].

3. These figures are not contradictory because they refer to different reporting periods: $94,930 is for the most recent quarter, while $391,035 is for the entire fiscal year [1].
